## Logs

Attach the bridge log. By default it is `devicefarm-connect.log` in the runtime directory. That directory is `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/devicefarm-connect`, or a per-user directory under the system temp directory when that variable is not set. If you started the bridge with `bridge start --log <path>`, attach the file at that path.
